main_text.p: כרוּבָא Ch. Grando major, Psal. 78. 47. Hebr. חַנָּמַל. כַּרְזְבָא Chald. Species locustæ, cicada, vel cantharus, Resp. Hebr. חָגָב Lev. 11. 22. in Targ. Jon. Sic habent Veneta. Elias & Baal Aruch legerunt כְּרוּבָא.
כְּרָחָא Ch. Vis, coactio, בְּעַל כּוּרְחָךְ Per coactionem tui, id est, te invito, 1. Sam. 2. 16.

כָּרַךְ Ch. & Syr. Involvere, obvolvere, convolvere, complicare, operire, cooperire, tegere: Item Munire, Jerem. 51. 53. Item Alligare, annectere, Prover. 6. 21. Ithpeh. אִתְכְּרַךְ Involvi: Syr. ܟܪܟ Circumagi, circumire, peragrare, pertransfire, Aphel ܐܟܪܟ Circumducere, 1. ad Cor. 9. 5. Pahel כָּרֵךְ Operire, cooperire, tegere, obvolvere, involvere: Item Circumire, verti, converti, ex significatione Syriaca, Prov. 26. 14.
כְּרִיכָא, כָּרִיךְ Ch. & Syr. Convolutus, involutus: Munitus. Plur. כְּרִיכִין. Fœm. כְּרִיכְתָּא Munita, Jesa. 36. 1. Plu. כְּרִיכָן.
כַּרְכָּא כָּרֵךְ Ch. ܟܪܟܐ Syr. Munitio, arx, urbs munita. Plur. כַּרְכָּיָא, כַּרְכִּין, Syr. ܟܪܟܐ, Affine est Græc. χάρξ.
כַּרְכּוֹם Chal. Idem. Plur. כַּרְכּוֹמִין Deut. 20. 20. in Onk. convenit Græc. χαρχωμα.
ܟܪܟܢ Syr. Involucrum, fasciculus, 2. ad Tim. 4. 13. Vide ibi notas D. Junij.
כּוּרְכְּיָא Ch. Grus. Jerem. 8. 7. Heb. סוּס.
